entities.name: NSAG information
entities.description: Information element that provides NSAG (Network Slice Assistance Information for Group) information to the UE when the UE has indicated NSAG support.

entities.name: 5GMM capability
entities.description: Information element containing UE capabilities for 5G mobility management.

entities.name: NSAG bit
entities.description: A bit in the 5GMM capability IE that indicates whether the UE supports NSAG functionality.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to initiate registration procedure with the network.

entities.name: NSAG supported condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE has set the NSAG bit to indicate NSAG support in the 5GMM capability IE.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the 5GMM capability information element.
5GMM capability IE contains the NSAG bit field.
When NSAG supported condition is met, the network may include NSAG information IE.
NSAG bit value guards the NSAG supported condition.
